from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "Be terse."),
    ("human", "{question}"),
])
chain = prompt | init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini") | StrOutputParser()
print(chain.invoke({"question": "What is a Runnable?"}))

run: pip install langchain langchain-openai && python agent_openai.py
code:
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float:
    """Multiply two numbers."""
    return a * b

agent = create_agent(init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini"), tools=[multiply])
print(agent.invoke({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 12 * 7?"}]}))

from llama_index.core import Document, VectorStoreIndex, Settings
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI
from llama_index.embeddings.openai import OpenAIEmbedding

Settings.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini")
Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents([
    Document(text="LCEL composes LangChain Runnables with the pipe operator."),
])
print(index.as_query_engine().query("What is LCEL?"))
